{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    color=min((v for v in cnt if v!=bg),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Scatter the object from every background cell, preserving the original pattern.
    anchors=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==bg]
    for r,c in anchors:
        for dr,dc in shape:
            if r+dr<h and c+dc<w: g[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return g
",
